tasks.description: Enable nullable reference types in production projects
tasks.requirements: Turn on nullable reference types for the production projects already on .NET 10, then fix resulting warnings and compile issues without changing the target framework.

tasks.description: Clean up legacy package and build-tool references
tasks.requirements: Review the production manifests for stale or redundant references, remove packages that are no longer needed, and align the remaining packages to the current baseline where usage still requires them.

tasks.description: Decouple database and identity seeding from normal startup
tasks.requirements: Move seeding out of unconditional startup paths so web apps can start without performing database and identity initialization during every launch.
